policy: These are proposed review intervals and decision conditions, not externally mandated or empirically validated thresholds.

triggers.signal: Exact allowed data/model/tool route and accountable review/stop authority
triggers.holder_or_proposed_owner: Proposed sponsor and security/data authority with service owner
triggers.cadence: Immediately on a decision/change and before any execution
triggers.evidence: Actual scope-specific approval/denial and accepted owner/cover record
triggers.threshold_or_event: Previously blocked route becomes explicitly permitted, or existing permission/cover is withdrawn
triggers.action: Reopen eligible comparison options or halt dependent evaluation; return authority/readiness questions to humans/SubAgent6.

triggers.signal: Vendor feature surface, release status, eligibility and complete current terms
triggers.holder_or_proposed_owner: Proposed platform owner and procurement/finance role
triggers.cadence: Every14days; next planned check2026-11-30, and immediately before use/commitment
triggers.evidence: Original dated/current vendor docs, actual tenant settings/capacity/region and applicable quote/terms
triggers.threshold_or_event: Material feature/eligibility/deprecation/terms change or stale unverified quote
triggers.action: Refresh the comparison; suspend dependent availability/price claims until confirmed. Never infer chart validation from report assistance.

triggers.signal: Protocol revision, security notice and actual host/server behavior
triggers.cadence: Monthly; next planned check2026-12-16, and on a security or integration change
triggers.evidence: Original revision/release/security notice plus exact-version consent/access/log/compatibility test
triggers.threshold_or_event: Relevant incompatible revision, access behavior change or unsupported interface
triggers.action: Reassess integration/exit effort and isolate affected route; a spec publication alone does not require migration or authorize access.

triggers.signal: Relevant independent empirical research and its dataset maintenance/date
triggers.cadence: Weekly maintained research-feed review; next planned check2026-11-23; before any model ranking
triggers.evidence: Original methods/data with task population, model/tool version, observation date, coverage and reliability definition
triggers.threshold_or_event: A maintained, sufficiently task-matched new result; source becomes inactive or conflicting
triggers.action: Update confidence/test priorities, not automatically a go decision. METR September8 data remain historical even when reopened.

triggers.signal: Local comparator performance and complete workflow cost
triggers.holder_or_proposed_owner: Proposed reporting/process owner and evaluation lead
triggers.cadence: Every model/tool/reference/workflow change and before any broadened use
triggers.evidence: Authorized representative source-linked tasks, reference answers, misses/false corrections/abstentions and all setup/review/correction/support/exit effort
triggers.threshold_or_event: Pre-agreed material error condition fails, or meaningful full-effort benefit over adequate baseline is demonstrated
triggers.action: Escalate/stop on material failure; otherwise send evidence to Adoption and readiness review. Owners set task-specific tolerances before outcomes.

triggers.signal: Analyst attention, investment and broad industry adoption context
triggers.cadence: Quarterly and when a directly relevant new primary observation appears
triggers.evidence: Dated analyst context and original task/industry denominators; distinguish forecasts from observations
triggers.threshold_or_event: Evidence actually changes a specified dependency or the available comparator set
triggers.action: Revise only the affected rationale; news volume or generic funding alone does not reopen operating release.
